lead.headline: Achane is out for the season, and AVIATO is 0-3
lead.deck: A torn ACL, confirmed Monday. Claim Ollie Gordon II before Wednesday 01:00 and drop Achane.
lead.body: De'Von Achane tore his ACL on a first-quarter cut at Miami and will miss the rest of the season, CBS Sports reported Monday, citing ESPN and NFL Media. Chem has no IR slot, so he is now a roster spot that cannot score. Ollie Gordon II played 84% of Miami's snaps after the injury, and the claim for him, with Achane as the drop, processes at 01:00 Wednesday Mexico City. The other two injured starters look minor: Justin Jefferson's MRI showed an ankle sprain and he might play Sunday, and Jalen Coker has a minor quad strain. Footballers finished on 140.6 against AVIATO's 103.8. The lineup was the projection lineup; three starters got hurt.

players.caption: Torn ACL; out for the season.

doFirst.note: If Jefferson or Coker can't go in Week 4, McLaurin starts, then Boston. That card waits for Wednesday-Friday practice.
